summary.text: Bobby Wilson is the Libertarian Party nominee for Arkansas's 3rd Congressional District. He previously ran for this seat in 2024, losing to Steve Womack, and lists management as his profession. Public information about his background is limited.

paragraphs.text: Born in Greenville, North Carolina; has a career background in management.
Ran for Arkansas's 3rd District in 2024 as the Libertarian candidate, losing to Womack in the general election.
Advanced from the Libertarian Party convention on February 22, 2026 as the party's nominee.
